Head of Academy

Jordan Naughton

Head coach, U17, U19 and the Stevnsgade girls team

  • NCAA Division 1 at the University of Wyoming, Mountain West Conference
  • Pro in Denmark with BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • 6'9" forward from Rancho Cucamonga, California
  • Coached at Canada Camp 2026 in Lethbridge, Alberta
jordan@talatabasketball.dk

Playing

Jordan grew up in Rancho Cucamonga, California, and played his high school basketball at Etiwanda. He played NCAA Division 1 at the University of Wyoming in the Mountain West and graduated in 2019.

  • Career night against Western State in November 2016: 20 points and 14 rebounds, 9 of 9 from the floor, his first double double
  • 15 points and five dunks at San Jose State in January 2017
  • Pro with BK Amager in the Basketligaen
  • Plays for Talata Men in Copenhagen

His college record is on the Wyoming Cowboys roster page.

At Talata

Jordan runs the Talata Academy. He is head coach of U17, U19 and the Stevnsgade girls team, and he coached at our Canada Camp in Lethbridge in July 2026.

Train in the Academy

Your first session is free. Send us your date of birth and we will tell you which team and which night.
